{@body const [tokens,setTokens]=DIL.useState(100)}
{@body const [inputPrice,setInputPrice]=DIL.useState(2)}
{@body const [outputPrice,setOutputPrice]=DIL.useState(8)}
{@body const [ratio,setRatio]=DIL.useState(30)}
{@body const inputTokens=tokens*1000000*(1-ratio/100)}
{@body const outputTokens=tokens*1000000*ratio/100}
{@body const totalCost=(inputTokens*inputPrice+outputTokens*outputPrice)/1000000}
<box border radius="2xl" padding={4} gap={3}>
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    <box gap={1}>
      <title>LLM API Cost Simulator</title>
      <caption>Token 成本模拟器 · 所有数据可调整</caption>
    </box>
    <badge>Local state</badge>
  </row>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row justify="between">
      **总 Token 数量**
      <text weight="medium" tabularNums>{tokens}M</text>
    </row>
    <slider min={10} max={500} step={10} value={tokens} onChange={setTokens}/>
  </box>
  <box gap={1}>
    <row justify="between">
      **Output Token 占比**
      <text weight="medium" tabularNums>{ratio}%</text>
    </row>
    <slider min={5} max={80} step={5} value={ratio} onChange={setRatio}/>
  </box>
  <grid columns={2} gap={3}>
    <grid-item>
      <box gap={1}>
        <label>Input / 1M tokens ($)</label>
        <input inputType="number" value={String(inputPrice)} onChange={v=>setInputPrice(Math.max(0,Number(v)||0))}/>
      </box>
    </grid-item>
    <grid-item>
      <box gap={1}>
        <label>Output / 1M tokens ($)</label>
        <input inputType="number" value={String(outputPrice)} onChange={v=>setOutputPrice(Math.max(0,Number(v)||0))}/>
      </box>
    </grid-item>
  </grid>
  <box background="surface-secondary" padding={3} radius="xl" gap={1}>
    <caption>估算总费用</caption>
    <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>${totalCost.toLocaleString("en-US",{maximumFractionDigits:2})}</title>
    <text color="secondary" size="xs">Input {(inputTokens/1e6).toFixed(1)}M · Output {(outputTokens/1e6).toFixed(1)}M</text>
  </box>
</box>
